explanation: Kinematics (W=1.7 GeV, Q2=1.0 GeV^2, cos_theta=0, phi=90 deg) passed all physics checks for the eta channel. The requested vcut=-0.1 was corrected to the channel default of 0.166 GeV^2: a negative vcut switches EXCLURAD to its alternate 'v' interpretation (per the preflight WARN), which is almost certainly not what was intended for a standard radiative-correction calculation. Beam energy defaulted to 6.53 GeV (CLAS12 RG-K, the validated eta campaign); alternatives are 10.6 GeV (RG-A) and 10.2 GeV (RG-B) for different but valid results. rc_mode=full (O(alpha)) was used as in all validated runs. Note: the input file contains non-printable/inert bytes (the '0error detected by nag library...' trailer line kept for byte-compatibility) and may appear as binary to some readers.
